description: exploring space and trying to learn more about data science
summary: Our suggestion is to study maars on Earth in order to help identify the maars on Mars. The method includes searching the key characteristics of the maars such as substance and the shapes. Later these findings can be cross-correlated with the craters observed from the orbit of Mars. The classification of these craters are poor and maars classified only as candidates.
details:
Our project compares maars on Earth and Mars. Through this comparison, we can deduce the geological behaviours of the planets that are analysed. We used various data and articles to understand the maars identified on Mars. We deduced that there is very little research about these. Moreover the catalogs of craters of Mars lacking the reason of creation.

Especially, considering that for a maar to come into existence, a water resource is needed, classification of these craters is important to also understand the history of the planet. Since we can observe similar actions on different planets by comparing them to Earth, one of the most analysed planets, we can further understand the geology of other planets and also the minerals they might contain.
